description.zh: 选择查询新版安全分或旧版安全分规则，当取值为**home_security_score**时，查询新版安全分规则，否则默认查询旧版安全分规则。
description.en: Specifies whether to query the new or legacy security score rules. If the value is **home_security_score**, the new security score rules are queried. Otherwise, the legacy security score rules are queried by default.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

title.zh: 查询自定义安全评分规则详情
title.en: Query custom security scoring rule details

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-security-score-rule --lang zh --cal-type home_security_score --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetSecurityScoreRule --region cn-hangzhou --CalType home_security_score --Lang zh
